name: signal
notes: No delivery semantics in QDOS/386; no fake handlers.

name: raise
notes: No delivery semantics in QDOS/386.

name: SIGABRT
notes: Signal numbers are declared only if signal.h exists; no delivery.

name: wchar_t
notes: No wide-character library; the type is declared only if the header provides it.

name: fopen
notes: Read modes only (FAT16 read-only); write modes fail.

name: freopen
notes: Same stream model as fopen.

name: gets
notes: Deprecated in C11, required by C89; reads stdin without a size limit.

name: remove
notes: FAT16 is read-only. Kernel/filesystem-blocked.

name: rename
notes: FAT16 is read-only. Kernel/filesystem-blocked.

name: tmpfile
notes: Needs a writable file; FAT16 is read-only. Kernel/filesystem-blocked.

name: tmpnam
notes: Needs a writable file namespace. Kernel/filesystem-blocked.

name: abort
notes: Terminates the job with status 3 without flushing stdio (C89 requirement is termination, not flushing).

name: getenv
notes: No environment. Always returns NULL.

name: mblen
notes: Locale is the C locale only (one byte = one character).

name: mbstowcs
notes: C locale only.

name: mbtowc
notes: C locale only.

name: system
notes: No command processor. system(NULL) returns 0; a command returns -1.

name: wcstombs
notes: C locale only.

name: wctomb
notes: C locale only.

name: asctime
notes: Pure formatting; static buffer.

name: clock
notes: Unavailable by design: returns (clock_t) -1. Not CPU time; not wall time or ticks.

name: ctime
notes: UTC only; NULL when the time is unavailable. Static buffer.

name: difftime
notes: Pure arithmetic on time_t.

name: gmtime
notes: UTC; NULL for NULL or times above 0xFFFFFFFE. Static buffer.

name: localtime
notes: Identical to gmtime (UTC only).

name: mktime
notes: UTC; normalises fields; -1 before 1970, after 2106-02-07 06:28:14 or on overflow.

name: strftime
notes: C89 conversions only; %Z = UTC; fails (0) on unknown conversion or short buffer.

name: time
notes: UTC wall clock from the kernel anchor; unavailable (-1) when no clock is configured. Range 1970..2106.
